meta.description: Gives the paths that pass through their own fibrous relief in hyphae_to_mesh, in place of its fibres: a fibrous stipe next to a silky cap. The fibres are written into every point of the paths, the paths without them keep the fibres of hyphae_to_mesh.

plant.description: The paths, they pass through with their fibres. Everything else passes through as it is.

fibres.description: Relief along these paths, 0 leaves their surface smooth. It is read for every path, with path_info and random per path, and along it with alpha, so a curve of alpha makes the relief fade towards the tip. Where two values meet, the relief goes over from one to the other in a few rings of the mesh.
